_what: The slides for act VI's INTERRUPTION (issue #104, the owner's solution to #95): at bed 322.200 the song pauses, the CNCF Ambassadors interrupt the film, and the gameplay-trailer clip is played to the audience with its own effects and score. These are the three full-screen stills the pause is built from; the clip itself is footage and lives in scripts/build_wolves.py (CLIP_IN/CLIP_OUT, source clock).
_copy: Every string here is OWNER-AUTHORED and reproduced VERBATIM, including 'Weilder' and the spaced ellipsis in 'Introducing ...'. Authored copy is never silently corrected. Card C's Guardian plate is the same authored identity already on screen in act I (stories/megacut/megacut-hero-plates.json id 'cortney', issue #90) -- the class row stays OMITTED, not forgotten, exactly as there: her class was never named and a hint is not an authorisation (#59/#90 stay open).
_rights: The CNCF MARK (logo) is NOT on the slide: the rights to it have not been cleared, and rights are one of the two things that genuinely stop work. The slide is the owner-authored line as text only, until the owner says otherwise.
_render: scripts/build_interruption_cards.py renders these to renders/interruption/<id>.png, flattened onto OPAQUE BLACK (a transparent PNG concatenated as a still is the megacut skill's standing red flag). scripts/build_wolves.py consumes them via its interruption() helper, falling back to a marker card if a slide is missing (degrade, never block).
_clocks: dur is ACT-FILM seconds and must equal the matching constant in scripts/build_wolves.py (SILENCE_LEN / SLIDE_LEN / PLATE_LEN) -- a test pins the two together. None of these beats consumes BED time: the song stays paused at bed 322.200 across all of them.

cards.note: A: the realization. The song stops and NOTHING has appeared yet -- a held beat of black with true silence (audio='silent', a promise this beat never carries sound). 1.0 s is the ordinary pre-punchline beat from the issue's craft guidance.

cards.title: The CNCF Ambassadors would like a moment.
cards.note: B: the mark, as TEXT ONLY (the logo is rights-blocked, see _rights). Owner-authored line from issue #104, verbatim. Plays under the hold-music slot (audio='hold'), silent until the owner clears a track -- see unresolved. 4.0 s: hold music wants 3-4 s; longer on a static element tips into dead air (craft guidance, not measurement).

C: the name. 'Introducing ...' is the owner-authored framing line from issue #104, verbatim; the plate reproduces her authored act-I identity (issue #90) with NO class row -- omitted, not forgotten (#59). NO WREATH: whether the interruption treatment should add one is the owner's call, recorded in unresolved. Also under the hold-music slot.

unresolved: HOLD MUSIC, TODO(owner): cards B and C (and the silence of A) sit in the interruption's 'hold' audio slot. No cleared elevator/hold-music asset exists on this machine, and picking a track is a licensing decision -- so the slot ships SILENT and recorded rather than filled with an unlicensed track. When a track is cleared it is wired in as audio_from on the two hold shots in scripts/build_wolves.py; the joke is that the explosion at D smashes the polite music out.
CNCF MARK, TODO(owner): the slide carries the owner-authored line only. If the rights to use the CNCF logo are cleared, the mark joins the text on card B.
WREATH, TODO(owner): Cortney's plate here reproduces her act-I treatment exactly -- no laurel wreath. If the interruption should show one, say so and card C gains it.
CORTNEY'S CLASS: unrecorded. The class row stays omitted until the owner names one (#59/#90); it is never guessed.
